theorems.name: Submission.f036cc6b1f_fd_norm_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), ∃ C Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : UpperHalfPlane, Y ≤ z.im → ‖ModularForm.norm (MonoidHom.range (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ →* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℝ)) f z‖ ≤ C * ‖f z‖
theorems.natural_summary: Every coset factor is an integral slash translate of the cusp form and tends uniformly to zero above increasing heights. Finiteness gives a common height where all factors have norm at most one. Separating the identity factor f bounds the product by ‖f z‖, so C = 1 works, including the empty remaining-product case.
